newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan BSPA to tender for 54,000T U.S. soybeans.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan BSPA to tender for 54,000T U.S. soybeans.

text.p: The Taichung division of Taiwan's Breakfast Soybean Procurement Association will tender on Tuesday for a 54,000-tonne shipment of U.S. soybeans, traders said on Monday.

Traders had said the Taichung division's tender was highly likely following Friday's purchase of 54,000 tonnes of U.S. soybeans by an unaffiliated rival, the Breakfast Soybean Procurement Association Kaohsiung division.
The Taichung division consists of Sino Japan Feed Corp, Chia Hsin, Formosa Oilseed, Fwu Sow Grain and Tay Shan.
